program.name: freeway-entry-wait-examples-v1
program.guidance: Execute this rule, including WAIT when required. The controlled chicken is x=44..50. UP moves toward smaller y, about 1 pixel/frame; each decision lasts 16 frames. Check only the lane directly ahead that UP can enter within 16 frames. A car box is [x,y,8,10]; chicken box is [44,p,6,8]. Consider a car only if y+10 <= p < y+26. If none qualifies choose UP. Estimate car speed v from its current and latest historical x divided by elapsed frames, correcting horizontal wrap by the shortest signed displacement. Entry time a=p-y-10; final checked time b=min(16,p+8-y). For any time t from a through b, predict car left edge q=x+v*t with screen wrap. If q+10>44 AND q-2<50 at any such time, choose NOOP. Otherwise choose UP. Examples from training: p=52, car=[46,27,8,10], previous x=50 sixteen frames ago: v=-0.25, entry=15, q=42.25 at entry, so NOOP. p=139, car=[48,123,8,10], previous x=40 sixteen frames ago: v=0.5, entry=6, q=51; its 2-pixel margin still overlaps, so NOOP even though it moves away. p=185, car=[8,171,8,10], previous x=5 sixteen frames ago: car remains far left, so UP. Other lanes must not distract from the eligible lane. If already inside a lane, do not wait for that lane; continue UP unless the next eligible lane triggers the rule. DOWN is not prescribed. Do not replace the conditional rule with constant UP.

action_criteria.NOOP: Choose when the eligible car overlaps x=44..50 with margin 2 during predicted lane entry; both training waiting examples require this.
action_criteria.UP: Choose only when no eligible car has that predicted overlap. Passing already entered lanes still uses UP.
action_criteria.DOWN: Not required by this rule; no condition selects retreat.
